verdict.rationale: Stripe is API-first and runs without a UI. API keys authenticate programmatic requests, and restricted keys give least-privilege credentials for agents and automation. The official CLI builds, tests and manages integrations from the command line, and `stripe sandbox create` provisions an anonymous sandbox with working API keys and no account registration. Isolated sandboxes, test cards and idempotent retries make automated test runs safe and repeatable. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g. non-interactive CLI auth or CI examples), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
